summary: Grifols SA filed a Form 6-K reporting board changes. Independent director Iñigo Sánchez-Asiaín Mardones resigned for professional reasons effective July 29, 2026, after nearly 12 years, vacating his Audit Committee chair and Strategy Committee roles. The board co-opted Joanna Susan Le Couilliard as independent director and Audit Committee chairperson, and appointed Montserrat Muñoz Abellana to the Strategy Committee. Although not a forced departure, this is a discrete governance event with specific board composition changes, disclosed via Spanish securities law article 227 as other relevant information.
